subject: Post-call MAP & revised milestones for BlueWave trial
messages:
From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: alex.thompson@bluewave.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-11-30T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call: MAP draft, milestones, and asks (BlueWave)

Alex — thanks for the time today. Short recap and next actions from the discovery call: 

- Shared draft MAP (link below) with target pilot scope: 3 models, 4 endpoints, 100k tokens/day.
- Proposed milestones (high level):
  1) Trial kickoff (config + data ingestion) — owner: BlueWave (prep) / Redwood (onboarding) — target: 2028-01-08
  2) Pilot validation (latency/cost baseline) — owner: Redwood SEs — target: 2028-01-22
  3) Commercial review & procurement — owner: BlueWave procurement / Redwood sales — target: 2028-02-05
  4) Production enablement (Dedicated capacity) — owner: Redwood infra / BlueWave ops — target: 2028-02-19

Open questions we flagged on the call:
- Procurement lead and internal approval deadline?
- Any compliance evidence (SOC2 / data residency) we should surface before vendor review?
- Expected burst load patterns (peaks per hour) so we can size Dedicated pools.

Attached: BlueWave_MAP_v2.xlsx (draft). Also uploaded to the shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-BlueWave-MAP

Requested next steps:
1) Can you confirm the procurement contact and any hard dates for approvals?
2) Confirm the pilot kickoff week (we penciled 2028-01-08).

If I don't hear back by EOD Tuesday I'll follow up — I can also loop solutions (Marissa) into a quick kickoff prep session next week.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: BlueWave_MAP_v2.xlsx
From: Alex Thompson <alex.thompson@bluewave.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: claire.dunn@bluewave.ai, procure@bluewave.ai
Date: 2027-12-01T09:24:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: MAP draft, milestones, and asks (BlueWave)

Thanks for the clear recap, Jonas — helpful. A couple items from our side: 

- Procurement just notified us their vendor review cycle slipped one month due to an internal audit. That will push our commercial approval date out. New tentative procurement completion: ~2028-03-10.
- Because of the audit, we need to move the heavy compliance evidence (SOC2 report, data handling docs) earlier in the MAP so our security team can start their review before the vendor packet goes to procurement.

Can you update the MAP to reflect a shifted commercial milestone and an earlier compliance checkpoint? We still want to proceed with the pilot readiness work (data ingestion + technical verification) earlier if possible — front-load the technical milestones and defer final contract/billing steps.

Cc-ing Claire (technical lead) and procurement. Claire — can you confirm whether the ingestion team can be ready for a 2028-01-15 pilot kickoff if we focus on sprinted onboarding tasks?

Appreciate it — Alex

Alex / team — quick technical note from SE side. We can absolutely front-load the onboarding work and split the MAP into two tracks:

Track A (Technical onboarding — prioritized):
- Data ingestion & sample data validation (owner: BlueWave + Redwood SE) — target: 2028-01-15
- Integration test (end-to-end inference with sample traffic) — target: 2028-01-29
- Performance baseline & quantization recommendations — target: 2028-02-05

Track B (Commercial + Compliance — deferred):
- Compliance package submission (SOC2, data handling docs) — target: 2027-12-10 (we should submit ASAP so your security can start review)
- Procurement review & PO (owner: BlueWave procurement) — target: 2028-03-10 (per Alex's note)
- Dedicated capacity enablement — target: 2028-03-24

I attached a version of the MAP with the dual-track layout and explicit dependencies: BlueWave_MAP_v2.xlsx. Please confirm Claire / procurement if the dates above look realistic.

If BlueWave needs a short 30-min technical sync this week to prioritize ingestion tasks, I have 11/04 and 12/03 windows (PST).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

- Reforecast target close: 2028-03-10 (was 2028-02-05)
- Moved Compliance checkpoint to 2027-12-10 so security can begin evidence review ahead of procurement packet
- Prioritized Track A kickoff: pilot ingestion readiness targeted for 2028-01-15
- Dependencies: performance baseline must complete before any Dedicated capacity sizing (see sheet tab 'Dependencies')

Next steps (action owners):
- BlueWave procurement (procure@bluewave.ai): confirm PO window and any contract SLAs you require by 2027-12-15.
- Claire (BlueWave): confirm ingestion readiness and any sample data constraints by 2027-12-08.
- Redwood (Marissa / Karthik): prepare a lightweight performance baseline plan and an onboarding checklist by 2027-12-09.

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-107; Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-BlueWave-MAP

I'll follow up next Tuesday to confirm the kickoff slot for the technical onboarding.

Best,
Jonas
